definition: Karl W. Steinbuch (June 15, 1917 in Stuttgart-Bad Cannstatt – June 4, 2005 in Ettlingen) was a German computer scientist, cyberneticist, and electrical engineer.
details: He was an early and influential researcher in German computer science, and was the developer of the Lernmatrix, an early implementation of artificial neural networks. From the late 1960s onwards the focus of his activity shifted from scientific research to right-wing political activism supporting the Neue Rechte.

explainer.lead: Karl Steinbuch was a German computer pioneer. His work spans cybernetics, informatics and computer science.

timeline.what: Receives the Order of Merit of Baden-Württemberg
